scope: Read-only retained-evidence, pinned-source and current-artifact audit; no inference or service mutation by auditor. Includes independent streaming SHA256 of the existing 2.497 GB Qwen blob at the final renderer verification.
confirmed_findings: Qwen Instruct-2507 original pinned tokenizer chat template contains no thinking branch or thinking tags, and its model card identifies a non-thinking model.

Imported Qwen Go template unconditionally appends an open <think> tag for the observed final-user case. The generation branch does not inspect Think or IsThinkSet. Every original and repair Qwen request explicitly has think:false.

On Ollama 0.34 rendered-Go-template path, think:false is passed as Think=false and IsThinkSet=true, and disables the generic thinking parser. That flag does not rewrite or remove the imported template prefix.
Stored Phi template matches its pinned original template for all observed one-user/no-tools messages. No prompt-format mismatch was found for that request shape.

All 24 inspected requests use one user message, no tools, fixed JSON schema, temperature 0, seed 7, context 4096 and output cap 2048. Retained responses terminate with stop below those reported token counts; no recorded thinking content appears.
The current imported template layers match the retained show output and reference the pinned weight digests. Current imported configs have no renderer or parser selector.
Actual original-alias debug response independently checked: _debug_info.rendered_template equals pinned HF rendering plus the eight-byte <think> newline prefix, despite think:false.
runtime_path_qualification: Ollama 0.34 has both rendered-Go-template and native-GGUF-Jinja paths. Stored /api/show alone was insufficient to prove the runtime path; this audit therefore requested actual debug rendering.

Parent subsequently retained an actual original-alias _debug_render_only response using think:false. Independent comparison confirms its rendered text is exactly the pinned HF rendering plus <think> followed by newline. This reproduces the mismatch in the installed runtime without answer generation.

Historical generation token streams were not captured. The reproduced runtime rendering, unchanged original template and retained request settings support the same-path explanation; causal impact on formula accuracy still requires controlled generation results.

causal_interpretation.statement: The installed runtime now demonstrably reproduces the unexpected open thinking prefix on the original Qwen alias. It is a concrete prompt mismatch and plausible contributor to poor output; formula-accuracy impact remains unproven. The candidate alias changes rendering path as well as prefix, and no equivalent Phi mismatch was found.

recommended_controlled_fix.source_confirmation: api/types.go CreateRequest defines model/from/template/stream; server/create.go replaces inherited template when nonempty and inherits base model layers.
verification: Create a separate alias only, preserving the imported model and pinned weight digest.

parent_debug_and_alias_followup.selected_template_source_explanation: routes.go selectedModelTemplate returns GGUF chat_template when chatModeForModel is native. images.go shouldPreferChatTemplate prefers a candidate with more capabilities. The minimal Go template contains no tool/thinking capability, whereas embedded Jinja contains tool support and assistant-history reasoning handling.
parent_debug_and_alias_followup.selected_jinja_difference: Embedded template has additional assistant-history reasoning handling and last-user tracking. Its one-user/no-tools generation prefix agrees with the original pinned template; general chat equivalence is not claimed.
parent_debug_and_alias_followup.scope: The created alias is a verified formatting repair for the six observed single-user/no-tools prompts: all actual rendered UTF-8 strings equal exact pinned HF rendering.
parent_debug_and_alias_followup.causal_control_limit: The alias can switch runtime rendering from Go to native Jinja. A subsequent accuracy improvement would support the overall formatting/runtime correction, but would not isolate removal of the thinking prefix as the sole cause.
